serialized_project.description: Script for Notion task tracking enablement with agent automation capabilities
current_capabilities: Create tasks in Notion database with title, assignedTo, notes, and status
identified_gaps: No task filtering or querying capabilities
No validation for required environment variables
Limited status management (only To-do and Done)
No CLI interface for command-line usage
business_requirements: Agent must be able to create tasks programmatically
Agent must be able to update task status throughout lifecycle
Agent must be able to retrieve and list tasks
Agent must handle errors gracefully without crashing
Agent must provide clear feedback on operations
Code must be maintainable and testable

numbered_task_definitions.title: Add Environment Variable Validation
numbered_task_definitions.description: Implement validation to check for required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) at startup. The script should fail fast with clear error messages if these are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Clear error messages displayed when variables are missing
Validation runs before any Notion API calls are made
Process exits with appropriate error code if validation fails

numbered_task_definitions.title: Create Environment Configuration Template
numbered_task_definitions.description: Create a .env.example file that serves as a template for users to configure their environment variables.
acceptance_criteria: Includes comments explaining where to obtain these values
README.md references this file in setup instructions

numbered_task_definitions.title: Enhance Error Handling and Input Validation
numbered_task_definitions.description: Add comprehensive error handling for all API operations and validate inputs before making API calls. Include retry logic for transient failures.
acceptance_criteria: All function parameters are validated before use
API errors are caught and logged with context
Invalid status values are rejected with clear messages
Network errors include retry logic (with exponential backoff)
All error messages are user-friendly and actionable

numbered_task_definitions.title: Implement Task Retrieval Function
numbered_task_definitions.description: Create a function to retrieve a single task by its Notion page ID. This enables agents to fetch task details for inspection or updating.
acceptance_criteria: Returns task object with all properties
Returns null or throws descriptive error for invalid IDs

numbered_task_definitions.title: Implement Task Listing with Filters
numbered_task_definitions.description: Create a function to query and list tasks from the Notion database with optional filters (status, assignee, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: Function can retrieve all tasks without filters
Support pagination for large result sets
Returns structured array of task objects

numbered_task_definitions.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
numbered_task_definitions.description: Create a function to delete (archive) tasks from the Notion database. Notion doesn't truly delete pages but archives them.

numbered_task_definitions.title: Add Task Search Functionality
numbered_task_definitions.description: Implement search capability to find tasks by title or content within notes using Notion's search API.
acceptance_criteria: Searches both title and notes fields

numbered_task_definitions.title: Add Batch Operations Support
numbered_task_definitions.description: Implement functions to create, update, or delete multiple tasks in a single operation for efficiency.
acceptance_criteria: Function to create multiple tasks from array
Function to update multiple tasks with same status
Includes progress reporting for large batches
Returns summary of successful and failed operations

numbered_task_definitions.title: Add Support for Additional Task Properties
numbered_task_definitions.description: Extend the task management to support priority levels, due dates, tags, and other metadata fields.
acceptance_criteria: Support for priority field (Low, Medium, High, Critical)
All existing functions updated to handle new properties

numbered_task_definitions.title: Implement Command-Line Interface
numbered_task_definitions.description: Create a CLI interface to allow command-line interaction with the task tracker without modifying code.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports create command with arguments
CLI supports list command with filters
Uses commander or yargs library for argument parsing

numbered_task_definitions.title: Add Comprehensive Unit Tests
numbered_task_definitions.description: Implement unit tests for all functions using Jest or Mocha. Mock Notion API calls to enable testing without live API access.
acceptance_criteria: Tests for createTask function with various inputs
Tests for updateTask function with various statuses
Tests for listTasks function with filters
Tests for validation and error handling
Notion API calls are properly mocked

numbered_task_definitions.title: Create API Documentation
numbered_task_definitions.description: Write comprehensive documentation covering setup, API reference, usage examples, and troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria: README.md includes all API function signatures
Usage examples for each function provided
CLI usage documented if CLI is implemented
Code examples are tested and working

tasks.rationale: Must validate environment before any operations
Provides template for users to configure environment

phase_2_core_operations.description: Essential CRUD operations for task management

tasks.rationale: Enhanced error handling needed before expanding functionality
Retrieval is prerequisite for other advanced operations
Builds on listing to add search capability
Extends data model with useful metadata
Provides user-friendly interface after core functions complete
Validates all implementations with automated tests
Documents complete system for end users

ambiguous_requirements.question: What are all the valid status values for tasks?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Code only uses 'To-do' and 'Done', but typical workflows include 'In Progress'
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Clarify complete status workflow and valid transitions

ambiguous_requirements.question: How should agent assignments be handled?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Code sets people: [] (empty array) despite having assignedTo parameter
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Clarify if 'Assigned To' should use Notion workspace users or simple text tags

ambiguous_requirements.question: How is the ID field used and managed?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Set to null with comment about auto-increment, but mechanism unclear
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Verify if Notion database has auto-increment formula or if manual management needed

ambiguous_requirements.question: Should tasks be archived or permanently deleted?
ambiguous_requirements.current_state: Notion API archives rather than deletes
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Clarify business requirement for task removal

Generated 12 detailed task definitions with dependencies
